verdict.rationale: Trello documents an in-app AI feature ('Use AI to help write or edit content'), so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows that assistant learning a user's tone, shorthand, or preferences to tailor its output. A generic AI writing aid is an adjacent feature, not personalization.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have my in-app AI assistant learn my tone, shorthand, and preferences to tailor its output
